Since complainant (PW1) did not support prosecution case, she was declared a hostile witness.
PW1 was cross- examined by Ld. Additional PP and during her cross- examination she denied all allegations levelled by her in her complaint.
She also denied that due to settlement with accused persons, she has not deposed true facts before the Court.
8. PW2 (son of complainant) testified that during lock- down, their family went into financial crisis and due to that his father went into depression.
On 05.11.2020 his father committed suicide by pouring petrol on himself and setting himself on fire.
After a month of his father's demise, accused Rana Iqbal Bahdur came to their house to get the house vacated.
His family got disturbed and his mother lodged a complaint against accused persons.

sentences.text: It is not disputed that PW1 is complainant and PW 2 is her son.
Both of them have not supported the prosecution case in respect of the allegations appearing in the FIR.
Both of them in unison deposed that accused persons were not responsible for committing suicide by deceased.
They also denied that accused persons sold their house fraudulently or demanded Rs 20 Lac from them.
Neither in the deposition of complainant nor in PW2 anything is said against accused.
No other witness is cited or examined by the prosecution who could have linked the accused persons with the allegations.

sentences.text: In the light of testimony of complainant and her son which are exonerating accused, it is held that prosecution has failed to establish charge against accused persons.
Accordingly, accused Rana Iqbal Bahadur Singh, Savita Rana and Dilip Kamath are acquitted.
Their personal bond is canceled and sureties are discharged.
Documents, if any, be returned to the surety.
In terms of Section 437(A) CrPC accused persons are directed to furnish personal and surety bond each in the sum of Rs.10,000/- for period of six months.
File be consigned to record room.
Announced in open Court on 21st day of January 2023.
GAUTAM MANAN
